package main

import (
	"fmt"
	htmd "github.com/xberg-io/html-to-markdown/packages/go/v3"

func main() {
	options := htmd.ConversionOptions{}
	result, err := htmd.Convert(`<ol><li>First</li><li>Second</li><li>Third</li></ol>`, &options)
